scope: Source inspection; component render provenance is recorded separately. No runtime or deployed workflow was exercised for this architectural explanation.
intent: Persistent agent identity and accountable coordination across temporary runtime sessions.

responsibilities.cockpit: Operator commands and queries through a gateway, plus state and event views.
responsibilities.control_plane: Agent/task identity, coordination, authorization policy and durable records.
responsibilities.surface_bridge: Authorized runtime execution requests, session mechanics, workspace setup and supported progress/results.
responsibilities.runtime: Runtime-specific tools, processes or API calls operating on project work.

limits: Adapter implementation is not current availability or equivalent capability.
Orchestrator continuity and summarized context do not promise perfect internal-state migration.
A reachable endpoint does not prove useful execution.
Small-size color-independent glyph discriminability has not been fully verified.
The review-gate tests are separate evidence; review-gate.json records the revision they ran against.
